exact_statement: There exists a finite dimension-independent K such that H(S_X|S_Y)<=K I_X(F) for every rare-tag bent-branch function F(x,a,b)=(-1)^(a dot b)g(x)(-1)^(1{b=tag(x)}), for every k>=1, m>=k+1 and every Boolean seed g on k uniform bits.
hypotheses: injective tags from k-bit X to m-bit B
proof_source: REPORT.md and CONDITIONAL_ENERGY_LEDGER.md section 4 (proved reduction; requested finite K remains open)
first_unproved_line: Existence of the finite K. The exact rare-tag limit reduces it to FEI(K) for every Boolean seed.
